title: wg: virtual-clients-01 L1521 The fan-out required by L191-194 tells the DS the number and identity...
description:
draft-ietf-mls-virtual-clients (virtual-clients-01), Privacy Considerations. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-virtual-clients at 65e960d, L1521.

Text: "Using a virtual client masks the emulation group's membership and activity from
other members of higher-level groups:"

Problem: The fan-out required by L191-194 tells the DS the number and identity of the emulator clients behind each virtual leaf, and usually which one submitted each message. Privacy Considerations omits this.

Suggested fix: Add a bullet stating that the fan-out DS learns the emulator-client set and the per-message submitter, unless the application uses another indirection.

Severity: low. Verifier: keep (Confirmed. L191-194 requires the DS to deliver to all emulator clients individually, which reveals the emulator-client set to the DS. Privacy Considerations (L1530-1555) lists other DS-visible metadata but not this.)

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21). Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
